name: octohog
description: Find UGC creators for your brand, analyze your TikTok and Instagram competitors, and check your creator campaigns, read-only from your Octohog workspace.

interface.longDescription:
Octohog is an AI workspace for UGC marketing, built for DTC brands and creative strategists. Connect it and ChatGPT can find UGC creators for your brand, show what your competitors' content is doing, and report on your creator campaigns.

Find UGC creators (Creator Match): describe the creator you need and set market, age range, language and follower range. ChatGPT returns ranked creators with the reason each one fits. Shortlists and outreach continue in the web app.

Competitor analysis (Radar): Octohog's agent runs daily checks on public TikTok and Instagram activity around each competitor, across their official, team and creator accounts, not only the brand handle. Ask what changed this week, which new creators and content angles are taking off, or how two competitors compare on posts, views and active creators. Answers come with the source posts: hook, caption, stored transcript and views.

Campaign tracking (Creator Tracking): see how a UGC or influencer campaign is doing without chasing status: delivery, top posts, content analysis and every captured post with metrics. Creator Match campaigns show status and outreach counts.

Video Blueprints: finished breakdowns of a TikTok or Reel (hook window, beats, on-screen text and ending), so ChatGPT can turn a winning structure into a brief your creator can shoot.

TikTok Creator Deep-Dives: a creator's typical performance, posting cadence, and top, worst and pinned videos, so you judge an account by more than one viral post.

Ask Otto: Octohog's AI marketing analyst answers open questions grounded in your workspace. Built-in prompts cover a weekly competitor summary, a script in a competitor's style, campaign status, quiet creators and what to brief next.

All 14 tools are read-only: ChatGPT finds and reads, while saving shortlists, sending outreach and starting new reports stay in the Octohog web app. Requires an Octohog account. Sign in with OAuth; ChatGPT sees only your workspace.
defaultPrompt: Find 10 UGC creators on TikTok who fit my brand.
What changed across my competitors this week?
How are my creator campaigns doing?
